mapper.sql: id, workflow_id, project_code, chapter_number, node, attempt, system_prompt, user_prompt, response_text, success, error_code, error_message, duration_ms, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_model_trace (workflow_id, project_code, chapter_number, node, attempt, system_prompt, user_prompt, response_text, success, error_code, error_message, duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{projectCode}, #{chapterNumber}, #{node}, #{attempt}, #{systemPrompt}, #{userPrompt}, #{responseText}, #{success}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chapter_model_trace WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
